title: Website Support & Maintenance
metaTitle: Web Support Agency Lancashire | Website Care & Retainers
metaDescription: Reliable website support agency for Lancashire firms. Proactive security, WordPress and Shopify maintenance, Core Web Vitals checks, and developer hours.
heroSubheading: Proactive website maintenance, continuous security hardening, and on-demand developer support to keep your business operating at peak performance.
summary: As an experienced web support agency, Lancashire Web Designers provides ongoing technical maintenance and proactive care for mission-critical business websites. We protect your digital investment with automated uptime monitoring, daily off-site cloud backups, regular core security patching, Core Web Vitals performance tuning, and direct developer support whenever you need site updates.
benefits: Proactive Security — Regular security patching protecting your site from malware and vulnerabilities
Automated Monitoring — Continuous uptime monitoring with rapid incident diagnosis
Daily Cloud Backups — Automated off-site cloud backups with straightforward disaster recovery
Speed Preservation — Ongoing performance audits maintaining sub-second mobile page speeds
Developer Access — Dedicated developer hours every month for content updates, tweaks, and feature additions

process.title: Initial Codebase & Security Onboarding Audit
process.description: We perform a thorough inspection of your website code, plugins, hosting environment, and DNS records to resolve latent vulnerabilities.

process.title: Automated Backup & Monitoring Implementation
process.description: Configuring real-time uptime health checks, automated database backups to secure European cloud storage, and firewall protection layers.

process.title: Staging Environment & Safe Updates
process.description: All core and plugin updates are applied and regression-tested on a private staging replica before deploying to your production environment.

process.title: Continuous Optimisation & Speed Tuning
process.description: Monthly caching adjustments, image compression checks, database table cleanups, and broken link remediation.

process.title: Transparent Monthly Reporting
process.description: Receiving a clear summary detailing uptime metrics, security scans, completed tasks, and strategic performance recommendations.

whatsIncluded: Automated uptime and SSL certificate monitoring
Daily automated off-site backups with 30-day retention
Managed security updates and vulnerability patching in staging first
Dedicated developer support time for content changes and new features
Same-day response for urgent issues during UK business hours
whatsNotIncluded: Complete architectural redesigns (discounted rates apply for plan members)
Resolution of hosting outages caused by unmanaged external budget hosting providers
priceNotes: Monthly care plans start at £49/month for standard brochure sites, scaling to £149/month for complex ecommerce or high-traffic platforms.

faqs.question: Can you support a website that you didn't build originally?
faqs.answer: Yes. We regularly take over management of existing WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, or custom sites built by other agencies. We begin with a comprehensive onboarding audit to review code quality, remove dormant plugins, and establish reliable backup routines.

faqs.question: What are your support hours and response times?
faqs.answer: We provide direct developer support during UK business hours (Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm). Critical issues receive same-day priority attention, and routine content requests are typically completed within 1 to 2 business days.

faqs.question: What can I use my included monthly developer hours for?
faqs.answer: You can use your allocated time for anything you need: publishing new case studies, adding team members, updating pricing, testing new landing page variations, adding interactive forms, or installing analytics tracking tags.

faqs.question: Are there long-term contracts or cancellation penalties?
faqs.answer: No. Our website care plans run on a rolling 30-day agreement. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time with 30 days notice.
